A simple issue which I stumbled upon. I can always reproduce it - the "next" button points to an incorrect page after changing sort settings. It happens for me with Chromium and Firefox, but I'm almost certain that it's strictly server-side, so browser doesn't matter.

How to reproduce:

  • Go to a sub with more than one page - for example: https://voat.co/v/bodybuilding/
  • Switch sorting to "TOP" - your url should be now: https://voat.co/v/bodybuilding/top - you'll probable see "It feels lonely" as it's not very active today, but this doesn't matter
  • Switch range to "all" - your url should be now: https://voat.co/v/bodybuilding/top?time=all
  • Scroll to the bottom and click "next" - it'll point to https://voat.co/v/bodybuilding/top?page=1 - it'll show "It feels lonely" - but it's incorrect as there are submissions to show.

The actual issue is related to link generation for the "next" button - in this example it should be https://voat.co/v/bodybuilding/top?page=1&time=all - such link when entered manually shows expected entries.
